faq.how_works.a: The app uses Kokoro and eSpeak, powerful text-to-speech (TTS) technologies, to convert your EPUB books into high-quality audio. Kokoro provides natural-sounding voices, while eSpeak offers additional language support and pronunciation accuracy.
faq.why_slow.a: Text-to-speech conversion is computationally expensive. Generating high-quality audio from text requires significant processing power, especially for longer books. The app processes each chapter sequentially to ensure quality and manage system resources efficiently.
faq.wait_completion.q: Do I have to wait until everything is done?
faq.wait_completion.a: No! You can start listening as soon as the first chapter completes. The app allows you to begin playback while conversion continues in the background. You'll be able to listen to completed chapters while others are still being processed.
faq.can_stop.a: Yes, you can stop the conversion at any time and resume later. The app saves your progress, so when you restart, it will continue from where you left off. Any chapters that were already converted will remain available for playback.
faq.audio_sync.a: Audio-text synchronization automatically highlights the text being read as the audio plays. When enabled, the reader will scroll to and highlight the current text segment, making it easy to follow along. You can toggle this feature on or off using the sync button in the audio player.
faq.multiple_books.q: Can I convert multiple books at once?
faq.multiple_books.a: Currently, the app processes one book at a time to ensure optimal performance and resource management.
faq.voice_selection.q: Can I change the voice for a book?
faq.voice_selection.a: Voice selection is set when you start the conversion process. If you want to use a different voice, you'll need to delete the existing audio tracks and start a new conversion with your preferred voice. The default voice can be changed in settings.
